title.narrative: Immediate response to provide temporary emergency shelter and restore basic living conditions for hurricane Ian affected people in the province of Pinar del Rio, Cuba.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Shelter and non-food items assistance to communities affected by Hurricane Ian in Western Cuba. This UNDP project provides shelter support to vulnerable people. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 54,639 people, including 21,722 women, 21,968 men, 10,949 children, and including 2,488 persons with disabilities.
